#### New findings

- **R1 — MAJOR — English `unknown` remains in localized clipboard durations.** `local_operator/info/render.py:343,392` interpolates `format_duration(None)` into translated messages. Actual `set_active_locale('fr'); build_export(InfoSnapshot())` contains `âge compilation   unknown` and `durée d’activité  unknown`. These are human missing-measurement values, not technical identifiers. The first stable `local-operator unknown · unknown install` prefix is explicitly excluded from this finding. **Fix:** localize the missing-duration value at the Info presentation boundary while retaining the global formatter/CLI contract; add a missing-duration clipboard regression.

- **R2 — MAJOR — production sentence composition drops the actual-PID command islands.** `local_operator/info/render.py:265–277` resolves the remedy to `InfoText` and then passes `remedy=str(remedy)` into the outer message, discarding its source/literal metadata. `local_operator/info/copy.py:80–92,136–151` can then recognize only generic `N` commands because the outer message has no `pid` parameter. With one wedged row (`pid=4243`, heartbeat age 65), the real Urdu `not_answering_clause → _Body.note → to_text` path has **no** LRI/PDI island for `'lop stop --pid 4243 --force'`, even at width **1000** (no wrapping). The direct remedy-helper control **does** preserve that whole-command island, explaining why the current test misses the production composition. At width 126 the actual sentence also wraps commands across projected fragments. **Fix:** preserve nested source and technical-span ownership through message composition and the final cell-wrap boundary; test the full one-PID sentence, not only the leaf remedy. This is an independently reproduced projection-contract failure, **not** a claim that native Urdu shaping has been validated.

- **R3 — MAJOR — translated Source rows publish cropped commit identities at widths that preserve English.** `local_operator/tui/widgets/info_panel.py:360,410–438,710–724`: the translated label column grows, but the Source value has no fitting ladder and is unconditionally cropped. Same synthetic snapshot (`source_ref='a1b2c3d4e5f67890'`) and `_Body(51)` retain English `git snapshot @ a1b2c3d4e5f6`; French paints `instantané Git @ a1b2c3`, Spanish `instantánea de git @ a1b`, Vietnamese `ảnh chụp Git @ a1b2c3d4e5f`, and Urdu `git اسنیپ شاٹ @ a1b2c3d4e5`. This is a new localized-fit regression, not the pre-existing English crop at width 47. **Fix:** fit this value with an invariant that keeps the complete identifying SHA (shed the surrounding prose before any SHA bytes), and add same-input English/localized narrow-width controls.

`esc / q retour · ctrl+r copier · r actualiser · ↑↓ défiler`
